scope: authorized disposable test fixtures only; planned cases, no runtime findings

execution_policy.privacy: Use fictional source content and redact identities, URLs with tokens, account IDs and private data. Do not publish or share outside test accounts; use link-only media unless redistribution is permitted.
execution_policy.authorization: Do not change account plans, connect production services, incur charges, change permissions of real objects or execute unrelated agent actions. Mark blocked if authorization, feature, plan, device or tool access is missing.

evidence_contract.unknown: null or explicit not measured; never infer runtime measurements from marketing stills

cases.title: Child object vs reference
steps: Create a disposable page; create a child and link to another disposable page
Rename and reopen the linked page and child
Move the child within the test space if authorized
checks: Identify whether object identity and navigation persist; distinguish reference from reparenting
Record inherited access separately from direct invitation

cases.title: Task, checklist and generated controls
steps: Open the creation menu on a blank test page
Add a checklist and, if enabled, a generated visualization using fictional data
Change an input, reload and inspect persisted state; do not execute a real agent task
checks: Record menu labels, available controls and the observed state owner
Separate scheduled tasks from checklist items and generated controls

cases.title: Workspace shell and accessibility
steps: Measure desktop panel widths at three viewports; collapse and restore a panel where supported
Use keyboard-only navigation to a page and editor; check reduced motion
Open a permitted read-only fixture and compare visible actions
checks: Record focus order, overflow, reflow, actual styles and reader role
Record only measured transition duration/easing; mark unavailable properties unknown

cases.title: Canvas selection and editor regions
steps: Create a fictional design with nested groups
Navigate between canvas, properties and chat using documented keyboard controls
Select, enter and leave nested groups; compare inspector open and closed
checks: Record focus target, retained selection and keyboard/pointer parity
Capture actual toolbar and inspector labels and any keyboard limitations

cases.title: Artifact editing and persistence
steps: Inventory available editor templates using the account's displayed plan and platform
Create a disposable spreadsheet or document with fictional content
Edit, reopen, inspect version history and export where enabled
checks: Verify identity and persisted edits; distinguish exported copy from original
Record visible version and export options; note unavailable templates

cases.title: Dashboard lineage and shared data
steps: Use synthetic data in an authorized test dashboard, without connecting production accounts
Inspect chart query/refresh metadata, keyboard interactions and history if available
Compare approved test reader and editor access only with explicit account authorization
checks: Record query access, freshness, snapshot/restore behavior and role boundary
No claim of live connector behavior when only synthetic input is available

cases.title: Library facets and pins
steps: Use an existing disposable test Bot or create one only if authorized
Produce a fictional page; inspect available facets and pin controls
Reopen and check cross-device pin state where a second session is authorized
checks: Record actual menu/facet labels, keyboard focus and pin persistence
Do not treat unavailable cross-device access as a failure

cases.title: Page reader state and recovery
steps: Generate a disposable page with a filter
Change a reader control, reload and compare page identity
Ask for a harmless edit in chat; observe update of the existing card
checks: Separate transient reader controls from persistent agent edits
Record loading, update indication and retry only if safely reproducible

cases.title: Agent handoff and shell
steps: Observe a harmless test task in an isolated agent environment if available
Open preview and take control only with explicit authorization; return control
Record status, focus and collapse behavior; do not access private files
checks: Distinguish indicator, preview and control ownership
Capture actual transition only from a permitted recording; no inferred easing

cases.title: Diagnostic learning states
steps: Create test learning materials with fictional topic data
Take a diagnostic and a follow-up quiz if enabled
Record dashboard labels and filter controls before and after
checks: Verify only visible state changes; do not infer mastery thresholds
Capture initial, progress and completion states with citations where available

cases.title: Generated editor and recovery
steps: Create a harmless local-state counter or quiz in Canvas
Inspect preview/code and edit selected content; reopen
Observe a recoverable preview error in a disposable draft if safe
checks: Document edit scope, state persistence, error and retry UI
No production connector or externally published app required

cases.title: Sharing boundary and responsive view
steps: Use a synthetic app in a permitted private test environment
Inspect sharing options without publishing unless authorized
Compare view widths and keyboard controls; test a copy using a permitted second account if available
checks: Distinguish private and shared storage and editable copy identity
Record actual permission wording and viewport, not inferred account eligibility

cases.title: Source-grounded review loop
steps: Use a fictional source document and generate a quiz or cards
Answer correctly and incorrectly, inspect explanation and source link
Exit, reopen and retry missed items when offered
checks: Record actual review states, source navigation and progress restoration
Separate learner state from source and generated artifact

cases.title: Staged artifact revision
steps: Generate a small disposable deck where plan allows
Mark a slide for deletion, restore it, and inspect preview before applying
Apply revision only if authorized; compare original and revised artifact
checks: Capture pending deletion and restoration with focus state
Record original/new identity, quota warning and failure controls where visible

cases.title: Three-pane shell and source tables
steps: Open a disposable notebook with fictional sources; inspect panel collapse and resizing
Generate a source-grounded data table where available; inspect citation navigation
Inspect export menu; export to test destination only if explicitly authorized
checks: Record dimensions, focus, responsive behavior and export as a separate object
Capture source and row references without private data
